tripRule: Trips are as reported in the covering email, which supersedes the workbook derivation.
movementRule: One movement is one transfer between locations: port to rig, rig to port, or rig to rig. Repositioning at the rig already occupied does not count, nor does a shift between two port-side locations.

dataNotes: The email now gives trips as IN and OUT. CA1 2 IN / 2 OUT, CA3 1 IN / 2 OUT, CA5 2 IN / 1 OUT, Charlie-3 8 IN / 8 OUT. The OUT figure is used for each vessel, because a trip starts with an outbound voyage. The IN and OUT totals are both 13, so the total is the same either way.
OPH is not shown from this week. It is off hired, and the email no longer reports it.

Truck moves now come from the workbook's Truck sheet, a new third sheet giving IN and OUT for each day: 23 in, 22 out. Reading the Port rows by the earlier rule gives 46. The one difference is a food lorry on 15.10 (E14), which the sheet leaves out; on 21.10 the sheet counts three lorries (E88, E89).

The Truck sheet counts pipe yard moves. E19 and E20 on 16.10 (a truck to and from the pipe yard) are in its figures. This settles the question left open in reports 28 and 29: those weeks' 79 and 70 follow the same practice.

CA3 drill water on 15.10 and 16.10: 864 or 648 m³. Port E17 records 216 on 15.10 and E28 648 on 16.10. Vessel E5 has 15.10 as 'in progress' and E9 648 on 16.10. Both Port rows are used. If 648 includes the 216, drill water bunkered is 1,332, not 1,548.

CA5 water on 19.10 and 20.10. Port E71 records 396 m³ 'drill and fresh water'. Vessel E22 records 200 drill and E26 180 fresh, 380 in all. The Port total is used: 180 fresh, as the Vessel sheet says, and 216 drill.

Port E97 and E98 are the same row, 108 m³ of fresh water to CA1 on 21.10. The email lists one CA1 fresh water line and one CA5 fuel line (72.004 m³), and Vessel E30 records the CA5 fuel. Read as one fresh water bunkering and one fuel bunkering. Vessel E28 also records CA1 receiving 100 m³ of drill water that day, with no Port row.
Well name SHU-0001R. The email's last week activities include 'Spudding of well SHU-0001R', and the call-offs now read OD-SH1R.

lines: One truck dispatched to COSL Mina Abdallah with two lifts received from OD1 (RCM-OD-957), per delivery ticket RM-SP-9093.

One truck dispatched to KOC DWS Hanger 1 to collect a 24" ECP and port collar and deliver them to Raith Engineering & Manufacturing Co. W.L.L at Mina Abdallah, per KOC delivery ticket 2026/10/21/0561.
Two trucks arrived from OWS Mina Abdallah with five baskets of TRS tools for OD1 (call-offs OD-SH1-B-1-13 and OD-SH1-B-2-13), per delivery ticket OWS-DT-TRS-082.
One truck arrived from OWS Mina Abdallah with 42 joints of 1.66" tubing for OD1 (call-offs OD-SH1-B-1-13 and OD-SH1-B-2-13), per delivery ticket OWS-DT-TRS-082.
One boom truck arrived from Solas Marine Mina Abdallah with a rack of three empty H2S cylinders for OD1, per delivery ticket HPM-DT-1621.
One truck arrived from OWS Mina Abdallah with a 4.5 m basket of fishing tools for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1-B-2-14), per delivery ticket OWS-DT-FIS-027.
Two lorries arrived at Shuaiba Port with CA1 food provisions; the provisions were offloaded and transferred to CA1.
One lorry arrived at Shuaiba Port with 10 full lube oil drums for CA1; the drums were offloaded, put in a cargo basket and transferred to CA1.
One truck arrived with Odfjell fishing tools for OD1 (call-off OD-SH-B-1-14).
10 full lube oil drums containerised and transferred to CA1; 24 empty oil drums offloaded from CA1 and loaded on the Al-Rashed lorry.
CA1 food provisions loaded in containers and transferred to CA1.
Cargo offloaded from CA1, per manifest RCM-OD-957.
Cargo offloaded from Charlie-3, per manifest RCM-OD-958.
Cargo loaded on CA1, per manifest CM-OD-1033.
108 m³ of fresh water bunkered to CA1.
72.004 m³ of fuel bunkered to CA5.
